Type locality Kartabo, British Guiana; the holotype is a major soldier, the morphotypes a minor soldier and an alate. sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Male. Head dark brown, oval, covered with short hairs and longer bristles. Fontanelle white, slit-like, shorter than the ocelli. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 much longer than segment 2 and slightly shorter than segment 1, segments 2 and 4 about equal. Eyes rather large and very prominent, close to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli rather large, directed laterally, separated from the eyes by about their own width. Postclypeus slightly paler than the head, with a median suture. Pronotum slightly paler than the head, proportionally rather long, posterior margin not or only very weakly concave, with hairs and bristles. Wings infuscated, with a pale streak between the media and the cubitus; wing membrane with short hairs and pigment spots. Abdominal tergites concolorous with the pronotum. Measurements: body length with wings 12.80 mm; body length without wings 6.00 mm; head length 1.37 mm; head width 1.30 mm; eye diameter 0.40 mm; pronotal length 0.70 mm, width 1.10 mm; hind tibia length 1.83 mm; forewing length 10.35 mm, width 3.06 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Major soldier: head dark brown, larger and thicker than in the minor soldier, widest at the antennal region, the elevation at the base of the nasus very distinct, posterior margin straighter than in the minor soldier; 4 bristles above the base of the nasus, 2 on the vertex, 2 on each side of the constriction, 2 on the genae; head distinctly constricted at the middle. Antennae about concolorous with the head, 14-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 about equal in length but segment 3 less thick than segments 2 and 4. Mandibles distinct and relatively large, with pointed teeth. Apex of the nasus paler than the head, the nasus relatively shorter than in the minor soldier, slender and slightly swollen apically. Pronotum with minute hairs, anterior margin with a few bristles. Abdominal tergites slightly paler than the head, with a row of bristles and bare on the posterior margin; sternites with long hairs and bristles. Measurements: body length 4.00 mm; head length 1.34—1.50 mm; head width 0.68—0.73 mm; antennal length 1.92—2.00 mm; pronotal width 0.60 mm; hind tibia length 1.54—1.60 mm.
Minor soldier: head concolorous with the major soldier, constricted at the middle, with a shallow elevation on the side at the base of the nasus; only a few bristles, 4 at the base of the nasus and 2 on the vertex. Antennae long, sometimes 14-segmented but mostly 13-segmented; when 13-segmented, segment 3 more than twice as long as segment 2 and swollen apically, segment 4 longer than segment 2; when 14-segmented, segment 3 about equal to segment 2 and without bristles. Nasus slender, relatively long, directed upwards. Anterior margin of the pronotum raised, not concave; without bristles but with minute hairs. Abdominal tergites with a row of bristles on the posterior margin, bare. Measurements: body length 3.50—4.20 mm; head length 1.25—1.50 mm; head width 0.57—0.73 mm; antennal length 2.40—2.67 mm; pronotal width 0.40—0.47 mm; hind tibia length 1.35—1.53 mm.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Closest to N. heteropterus (Silvestri), but the two soldier forms differ clearly from it in both shape and size.
